related_questions.question: How quickly does a sarcoma grow?

text_blocks.snippet: The growth rate of sarcomas varies widely. Some sarcomas grow rapidly, while others grow very slowly over years. Many factors influence the growth rate, including the specific type of sarcoma, its grade (how different the cells look from normal cells), and the individual's overall health.
snippet_highlighted_words: Some sarcomas grow rapidly, while others grow very slowly over years

list.title: Slow Growth:
list.snippet: Some sarcomas, particularly soft tissue sarcomas, can grow slowly over months or even years before becoming noticeable according to Moffitt Cancer Center. Synovial sarcoma, for example, can be present for a year or more before diagnosis.

list.title: Rapid Growth:
list.snippet: Other sarcomas, especially high-grade sarcomas or those in certain locations (like the abdomen), can grow noticeably faster, sometimes within weeks or months.
Type of Sarcoma: Different types of sarcoma, even within the same category (like soft tissue or bone), can have drastically different growth rates.
Grade: A higher grade sarcoma (meaning the cells look more abnormal and are dividing more rapidly) is more likely to grow and spread faster, says the Herbert Irving Comprehensive Cancer Center.
Stage: Higher-stage sarcomas (meaning they have spread further) tend to grow and spread more quickly.
Individual Variability: Sarcomas can even grow at different rates in different people, even if they have the same type and stage.

list.snippet: The Cleveland Clinic recommends that any new lump or swelling, especially if it's growing quickly, should be evaluated by a doctor. Even a lump that grows slowly over time should be checked out, as it could still be a sarcoma says HSS | Hospital for Special Surgery.

While some soft tissue sarcomas are slow-growing and can take years to become noticeable, others, especially those in stages 2 and 3, are more likely to grow and spread quickly. list.title: Factors influencing growth rate:

list.title: Importance of grade:
